fieldValues.title: Bin
fieldValues.summary: Blocks moved to the bin. Restore puts one back at the end of the page; Delete forever removes it for good, unless another page uses it or something derives from it.
fieldValues.explanation: Deleting goes through the Bin. Delete forever keeps a record that another container holds or that an alternative derives from: it only leaves the Bin.
fieldValues.ai_guidance: Never delete for the writer; say what Delete forever keeps.
